module: Node "Remove Vehicle" (category `repeat_instant`, tags gameplay/utils). Deletes a vehicle: informs the editor (`editor.onRemoveSceneTreeObjects`) if present, then `source:delete()`. Input pin: `vehId`.
notes: Called every frame while the flow is active; once deleted, `scenetree.findObjectById` returns nil.
`vehId` nil or 0: no deletion; the output flow is set to true.
The output flow is set to true only in the "no id" case.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Looks for the vehicle and removes it from the scene.
